brand_site_rating.note: Brand-hosted rating for the RJ38-SQSS-8T product page (5★ 523 · 4★ 131 · 3★ 42 · 2★ 10 · 1★ 11). Read 715 reviews on 2026-11-13, 716 on 2026-11-14 and 717 on 2026-11-16. commission.why_unverified: Category assignment per ASIN is not published by Amazon (S3).
commission.rate_source_note: Only the official Standard Commission Income Statement (S3) is used for rates. Third-party blogs claiming 3%, 4.5% or 5% for kitchen appliances were discarded: they disagreed with each other and with the published table on the day of verification.

competition.reason: Not published as a stable quotable fact; aggregation is restricted by S2. Read 2026-11-16: the listing page does carry a Best Sellers Rank line, and this repository's adopted reading of IP License §2(e) keeps Amazon-served ranking figures out of the site's tables rather than re-publishing them as market analysis. The field therefore stays empty by decision, with the reason stated on the row (F8).

flags.issue: Serious spec conflict between the Amazon listing (450 °F Hi-Fry, 4-in-1 including bake/dehydrate/frozen) and the brand page + owner's manual (200–400 °F, four food-type presets).
flags.action: Conflicting claims shown side by side; no value asserted. Narrowed 2026-11-16 by session ba29c641: the listing's own spec table states a 400 °F maximum and its Part Number identifies RJ38-SQSS-8T, so the 450 °F Hi-Fry wording now conflicts with the page it appears on rather than with a second site. What a buyer should take from this is on the product page; what remains open is which machine the seller actually ships. See F33 and F63.

flags.issue: Associates tag inside the short link not observable.

list_price_confirmation.v: 8 Quart: $119.99 USD list price, compare-at $119.99. (The same page sells a 5 Quart variant at $79.99, compare-at $99.99.)
list_price_confirmation.caveat: Taken from the store's own product record, not the page's promotional widget.

source_conflicts.note: Official documents that contradict a published specification value. Each entry names a row and the source id that contradicts it. The build fails if that source id appears in the row's source list, because a row's source list is read as the evidence for its value. The contradicting document belongs in the flag register, where it is the evidence of the conflict. Added 2026-11-15 by arena/88bb2db6.

entries.label: Included accessories
entries.reason: The Amazon listing title for the supplied link ends 'Six Cooking Accessories Included'. It contradicts the published 7. The brand page (S14) and the owner's manual (S15) both support 7 - the manual by enumerating 13 numbered parts of which 6 are built into the appliance, leaving 7 removable accessories - so the row cites those two and the listing is recorded in the flag register instead (F48, F50).

accessed_disclosure_note: Every row added on 2026-11-16 by session ba29c641 is sourced to the ASIN's own Product information block (S16, S28, S29) and labelled 'as listed by Amazon' so that a listing claim is never read as a manufacturer specification. Prices, availability, star ratings and review counts were visible in the same fetches and are not reproduced anywhere on this site, per S2 §2(b) and §6(t).
